definitions: The soft substance consisting of muscle and fat that is found between the skin and bones of an animal or human.
The edible part of a fruit or vegetable, especially distinct from the skin or stone.
The physical body and its needs and desires, as opposed to the mind or spirit.
The pinkish-yellow colour of human skin.
examples: The wound went deep into the flesh.
The flesh of the mango was sweet.
He struggled with the desires of the flesh.
The painting captured the subtle tones of flesh.
